Ekko

the Boy Who Shattered Time
Mid laneJungle lane

Ekko is just as popular in the jungle as in mid. He clears camps quickly, ganks from strange angles with Phase Dive and Parallel Convergence, and Chronobreak lets him escape invades and dives. Pick him in the jungle if you want an aggressive, high-mobility jungler who can also carry late.

When to pick Ekko

✓ Safe blind pick

Safe for a jungler: decent clears, an escape with Chronobreak, and he works with most team comps.

Pick into

  • Lanes with immobile enemies he can gank easily
  • Slow, scaling junglers he can invade after level 6
  • Squishy enemy backlines

Avoid into

  • Strong early invaders like Nidalee and Shaco
  • Teams with many tanks that soak his burst
  • Teams with heavy crowd control that stop his dives

Great teammates

LissandraHer crowd control locks targets for your ganks.
AhriCharm into your Phase Dive is an easy kill.
MalphiteA top laner with huge engage for dives.

Your team needs: Pick Ekko jungle when your lanes have some crowd control, so your ganks get kills.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Fast, healthy clears with Timewinder and Dark Harvest damage
  • Strong ganks: slow, stun and a blink onto targets
  • Chronobreak lets him escape bad invades and dives
  • Can carry fights late with burst on squishy targets

Weaknesses

  • Weak to early invaders like Nidalee and Shaco before he has items
  • Ganks fail if Parallel Convergence misses
  • Needs gold to stay relevant; a failed early game hurts
  • Less tanky than bruiser junglers in long fights

Power spikes

  • Level 3: full clear done and three abilities for ganks
  • Level 6: Chronobreak makes tower dives much safer
  • First item (Dusk and Dawn): stronger clears and fights
  • Two items (Shadowflame): burst on squishies
  • Three items (Rabadon's Deathcap): can one-shot carries

Top tips

  • Camps spawn at 0:55. Plan your first clear to end near the lane you want to gank.
  • Your jungle quest gives bonus move speed in the jungle and river. Use it to rotate faster.
  • Save Smite for objectives to prevent steals, not just for clearing.
  • Gank lanes with crowd control, like Lissandra or Ahri, for easy kills.
  • After level 6, dive under towers and Chronobreak out.
  • Track the enemy jungler: if they show up top, invade their bottom side.
